meta.name: functional-screen-analysis
meta.description: Analyze ENCODE functional genomics screens including CRISPR screens, MPRA (Massively Parallel Reporter Assays), and STARR-seq. Find screen data in ENCODE, process results, identify functional elements, and integrate with epigenomic annotations.

copy.tagline: 分析ENCODE功能基因组筛选数据，识别功能元件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在分析ENCODE功能基因组筛选数据
copy.tagline_en: Analyze ENCODE functional genomics screens and identify functional elements
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are analyzing ENCODE functional genomics screen data

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你查找和分析 ENCODE 数据库中的 CRISPR 筛选、MPRA 和 STARR-seq 等功能基因组学实验数据，包括下载结果、识别功能元件，并与表观基因组注释整合。
howto.when: 当你询问关于 CRISPR 筛选、MPRA 或 STARR-seq 数据，或需要分析功能验证的调控元件时触发。

say.text: 帮我找 K562 细胞中的 CRISPR 筛选数据。
分析 MPRA 结果中增强子活性最高的元件。
say.note: Claude 会处理 MPRA 数据并返回活性评分。

say.text: 将 CRISPR 筛选结果与 H3K27ac ChIP-seq 峰进行交集分析。
say.note: Claude 会整合两类数据并计算富集。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you find and analyze functional genomics screen data from ENCODE, including CRISPR screens, MPRA, and STARR-seq. It can download results, identify functional elements, and integrate with epigenomic annotations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about CRISPR screens, MPRA, or STARR-seq data, or need to analyze functionally validated regulatory elements.

say_en.text: Find CRISPR screen data in K562 cells.
say_en.note: Claude will search ENCODE for CRISPR experiments in that cell line.

say_en.text: Analyze MPRA results for top enhancer activity.
say_en.note: Claude will process MPRA data and return activity scores.

say_en.text: Intersect CRISPR hits with H3K27ac ChIP-seq peaks.
say_en.note: Claude will integrate both datasets and compute enrichment.
